    Profile

    Chat Noir is a phantom thief with a cat-cyborg appearance whose name is known across the continent. The only thing that's really known about him is that he always sends a warning letter with a cat mark on it before stealing works of art. He's taken something of a liking to Justin of the Civil Guard, and makes a point of teasing him.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Male
    Height: 177cm
    Weight: 67kg
    Birthday: Sep 29
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Baked sweets, high places
    Hobbies: Collecting art
    Illust: ─
    CV: 寺島惇太
